text:
maria: Heads up — I just hit a parity/bug in rb-sdk v1.3.2. When a streaming connection reconnects (network hiccup) the retry path sends the request without the Authorization header. Repro in the minimal sample app: start a streaming chat, kill the connection, then reconnect and you'll see 401s on retries.

sam: omg ok that's bad. do you have a tiny repro snippet?

maria: yup, minimal repro is the sampleapp streaming client. Relevant bit:
```ruby
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{token}"
# start streaming and yield chunks, simulate socket reset...
# on retry path we call perform_request(req) again but header missing
```

lee: hmm could be Faraday middleware mutation or our retry wrapper reconstructing request without headers. Which code path handles streaming reconnects?

maria: streaming uses the stream client wrapper in lib/redwood/stream_client.rb, it clones the original request for retries but apparently calls to_hash on headers lose symbol vs string keys. quick log: `headers_before_retry: {"authorization"=>"Bearer ..."}` then `headers_sent: {}`

sam: thanks. can you open a tiny PR with a failing test? I can review. if it's the header-key canonicalization we should normalize keys and preserve original case or use downcase consistently everywhere.

maria: opened draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference-rb/pull/432 — adds a test that simulates socket error and asserts Authorization preserved on retry. test uses Net::HTTP stub.

ci-bot: build queued: rb-unit, rb-integration, macos-arm-smoke

lee: quick glance at the draft — patch looks fine, but please add a short comment explaining why we deep_copy headers instead of dup (dup keeps shared substructures).

maria: added comment + small refactor to use deep_dup_headers in PR. also added a changelog entry under Unreleased/bugfix.

tasha: will smoke locally. one note: sampleapp readme has a streaming example that suggests retry is automatic — maybe we should mention this edge-case and recommend pinning to v1.3.3 once merged. could be onboarding friction for customers.

sam: agree. also add a tiny e2e in sampleapp CI that toggles a flaky socket fallback path so we catch regressions.

maria: ok will add sampleapp CI job as a follow-up issue. merging this after a quick review and green CI?

lee: +1. I'll review the test assertions tonight.

ci-bot: rb-unit failed: test_stream_retry_preserves_headers.rb: failure on macos-arm (flaky Net::HTTP stub). tagging @maria for info.

maria: seeing that, added a small sleep/await in test to make the stub stable on macOS. pushed a fix.

sam: cool. thanks for the quick turnaround. once merged let's cut a patch and ping support about a brief note in onboarding docs so customers aren't surprised. :thumbsup:
